senses.gloss: m. (v. preced.) leader, chief commander, only in דּוּךְ דּוּכָנִין (an adaptation of dux ducum, δώξ δωκῶν, v. Du Cange s. v.) the leader of the services of the Levites, v. דּוּכָן.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 10:3:3">Y. Sabb. X, 12ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:3">Num. R. s. 7</cite> (rendering of <he>נשיא נשיאי</he> <cite ref="Numbers 3:32">Num. III, 32</cite>).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, end [read:] <he>אלעזר היה דוך דוכנין וכ׳</he> Eleazar was chief commander, prince over princes; cmp. <cite ref="D00246"><he>דּוּכּוֹס</he></cite>.—*Pl. <he>דּוּכִים</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:3">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> (play on <he>ד̇כ̇י̇ם̇</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 93:3">Ps. XCIII, 3</cite>) (‘the rivers lift up their voices’, saying to the waves of the Sea) <he>דּוֹּכִֹיֹםֹ קבלונו</he> ye leaders, receive us; [<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 848:1">Yalk. Ps. 848</cite> <he>דַּכִּים אנו</he> we are crushed].
